meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。

meanings.note: Often used with に (お礼に) to mean 'in return / as thanks'.

examples.trans: I'll buy you a drink as thanks.

meanings.note: Polite/standard form of 金 (かね) with honorific prefix お.
Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.en: do a favor for the speaker
meanings.note: After a te-form (会ってくれる？), warmly asks 'will you do that for us?'

examples.trans: Will you come again for me?

examples.text: 母が料理を作ってくれました。
examples.trans: My mother cooked food for me.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.
Ichidan verb; often used for dedicating one's life, time, or effort.

examples.text: 人生を仕事にささげる。
家族にすべてをささげた。
examples.trans: I dedicated everything to my family.

meanings.en: a little while ago; just now
meanings.note: Refers to a recent point in time earlier the same day.

examples.text: さっきは何を売ったんだ？
examples.trans: What was it you sold earlier?

examples.text: さっき電話がありました。
examples.trans: There was a phone call just now.

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Contracts では; launches a decision ('well then') or opens casual farewell じゃあね.

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Limits the preceding noun or phrase to that item alone.

examples.text: これだけお願いします。

meanings.note: Colloquial conjunction built from だ + たら.
Colloquial particle adding emphasis, similar to でも or も.

examples.text: 俺だって言いたいことがある。
examples.trans: I have something I want to say too.

examples.text: 誰だって間違いはある。

meanings.note: na-adjective.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

meanings.en: do for an inferior (tough-guy てやる)
meanings.note: After て-form (勘弁してやる), expresses granting a favor from a position of authority.

examples.trans: I will give you a hand (casual masculine).

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Loanword from English 'series'.

examples.text: 新しいシリーズが始まります。

meanings.note: Loanword from English 'hotel'.

examples.trans: The hotel in front of the station.

meanings.note: Used for the physical world or a specific sphere/industry (この世界).

examples.text: この世界に入る覚悟はあるか。
examples.trans: Are you prepared to enter this world?

meanings.note: Refers to a person's life, career, and experiences.

examples.text: 人生を諦めないでください。
examples.trans: Please don't give up on life.

meanings.note: Refers to humans in general or human nature.

examples.text: 人間には表と裏がある。
examples.trans: Human beings have a public face and a hidden side.

meanings.note: Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.
Compound of 偽 (false) + 物 (thing); opposite of 本物.
分かってる asks or states ongoing understanding; plain past 分かった means 'got it! / I understand'.

examples.text: 日本語が少し分かります。

examples.trans: Got it, I will come right away.

meanings.note: て-form 売って links 'sell' into the next action.
Standard word for family.

examples.text: 週末は家族と過ごします。
examples.trans: I spend weekends with my family.
Everyone in my family is doing well.

meanings.note: Compound of 本 (true) + 物 (thing); opposite of 偽物.

examples.trans: It looks just like the real thing.

meanings.note: Four-character compound (四字熟語) emphasizing 100% authenticity.

examples.text: これは正真正銘の本物だぜ。
examples.trans: This is the genuine, real thing.

meanings.note: Used for someone's emotional state or sentiment.
Opposite of 裏 (hidden side); also means 'outside/front'.

examples.text: 人間には表と裏がある。
examples.trans: Human beings have a public face and a hidden side.
Go outside / come into the open.

meanings.note: Opposite of 表 (public surface); 裏の世界 means 'the underworld / hidden world'.

examples.text: 裏の世界を見せてやろうか。
examples.trans: Shall I show you the hidden world?
Write on the back of the paper.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.
Alone as 違う！ or 違います, means 'No, that's wrong!'.
Ichidan intransitive verb corresponding to 録る (record).

examples.text: ホテルで録れたシリーズだ。
examples.trans: It's a series recorded at a hotel.

meanings.note: Negative て-form 隠さなくて means 'without hiding / not hiding'.
